tasks.commitBody:
The standalone event-create form no longer decides the event type
for the user. The type select starts empty; the empty option cannot
be submitted — submitting without a choice is refused with the
existing field-pointing message, which #199 built as an unreachable
defensive floor and this change makes reachable.

All three 'rehearsal' literal sites are flipped (initial state and
both form resets), so reopening the form cannot quietly
reintroduce the default. The placeholder option is labeled by a new
key in four locales, following the season placeholder's pattern.
The #199-era comment asserting the select 'is never blank' is
rewritten — that rationale is superseded by the PO ruling on #242.

The series-create form keeps its default: a series has a genuine
dominant type, and its state (seriesCreateType) shares nothing with
the standalone path. Vocabulary (CANONICAL_EVENT_TYPES) and labels
are untouched; no schema, no migration.

Why it matters beyond its size: the old default is why #245 had to
exist — Joosep entered a concert as proov because the form had
already answered for him. #245 fixed the exit; this removes the
trap. The field drives the agenda badge colour (#211) and filter
chips (#214), so a silently wrong value was visible everywhere.

Live gate (Joosep): open 'Uus sündmus' — the type field asks
instead of assuming; submitting without choosing points at the
field; picking a type works as before.
